skill.summary: Organize and maintain a clean workspace file structure. Use when deciding where to save new files, which folder something belongs in, how to structure worksp...

latestVersion.changelog:
First public release of the Workspace Structure skill.
• Added a clear placement decision workflow for choosing where files and folders belong inside a workspace.
• Defined the meaning and intended use of key top-level workspace folders.
• Added rules for distinguishing temporary artifacts from durable files.
• Clarified how to handle ambiguous placement cases.
• Added output-style guidance for answering file placement questions.
• Linked supporting reference documents for folder taxonomy, edge cases, and naming conventions.
